results.text: Effect of insulin aspart combined with insulin detemir and metformin on islet function in newly diagnosed type 2 diabetes mellitus. This trial evaluated the effects of insulin aspart (IAsp) and insulin detemir and metformin on islet function in newly diagnosed type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM). A total of 96 T2DM patients were randomised into the control group (insulin detemir + metformin treatment) and the study group (insulin detemir + metformin + IAsp treatment), with 48 cases each. results.text: Effect of serotonin 7 receptors and transcript variants on RIN-5F pancreatic beta cell line. We first aimed to investigate the effect of 5-HT7 receptor agonist (AS19) and antagonist (SB269970) application on insulin secretion in RIN-5F pancreatic beta cells.
